title: Chapter 140: Human Warriors Ready To Go To War
content:
Chapter 140: Human Warriors Ready To Go To War

The adjustment of the scope of protection of the lords of the Great Xia Territory was completed, Wu Qing's consciousness entered the insect clone again, and Wu Cong happened to come in with two soldiers from the Great Xia leader's army.

The three of them are all big human race men wearing black armor and carrying swords at their waists. They walk like the wind and stand like a pine tree.

"I've met the lord!"

The three of them saluted respectfully.

"Please sit down!"

Wu Congyi sat down and two soldiers stood behind him.

Wu Qing's insect clone and the personal guards standing beside him were all wearing battle armor. Everyone gathered in a tent, and the style of the scene suddenly changed. It looked a bit like a meeting in a Chinese military tent during a war.

"How is the adaptability of biological reproductive equipment in the military?"

Wu Qing asked Wu Cong.

"Everyone has initially adapted and formed a fighting force, so we can fight!"

Wu Cong looked at the two soldiers behind him and said: "These two soldiers were randomly selected by me from the army. I brought them here just to let the lord see the results with his own eyes!"

"Okay, their strength is equivalent to that of my personal guards, let's let them fight!"

Wu Qing also wanted to see what changes would happen to these original human wanderers after they joined Daxia's army.

An insect guard walked to the middle of the tent. This tent was a military tent for the Evil God camp army. It was very spacious, and the space in the middle was enough for a battle.

A soldier from Daxia's army also walked into the field. After the two greeted each other, they started fighting together!

Both of them used knives. The insect guard's sword skills were simple and direct, attacking the vital points without leaving any room for error.

The soldiers of Daxia's army had flexible swordsmanship, good offensive and defensive skills, and were able to face the fierce swordsmanship of the insect guards with ease.

Both of them have one-star strength. The Insect Guard has the fighting instinct of the Insects, and the human soldier, who was originally a human wanderer, has rich combat experience and extraordinary martial arts. His strength was more than one-star.

The two of them were going back and forth, fighting in close combat, and their strength could be described as equally matched.

But the bugman is a bug after all. Fighting with a knife in human form is not his strong point. As he fights, the biological reproductive equipment on his body changes into arthropod-like weapons, attacking humans from various incredible angles. The soldiers attacked.

The human soldier raised his left hand and transformed into a shield to resist the various elusive attacks of the insect guards.

The human soldiers were not to be outdone. While resisting the crazy attack of the Zerg guards, they did not forget to use various small weapons transformed from biological weapons to shoot hidden arrows.

These secret attacks were difficult to detect and powerful. They hit the vital points of the Zerg guards several times. If it were not for the protection of the powerful biological reproductive equipment on the Zerg guards, they would have been defeated.

Wu Qing sent another insect guard, and Wu Cong also asked the remaining human soldier to join the battle to demonstrate teamwork.

Pairs of battles, and the weapons and equipment on the body can be changed at will. Various cooperative playing methods of both sides emerge in an endless stream, showing off to the fullest, making the fight inextricable.

Neither side made a fatal move, and the fight ended in a draw.

Wu Qing was very satisfied with the performance of the human soldiers. It was somewhat beyond his expectation that these soldiers, who had been equipped with reproductive equipment for less than two days, were able to exert such combat power.

Wu Qing could see that in a real life-and-death situation, the insect guards could not defeat these human soldiers.

These human soldiers who led Daxia's army have all experienced hundreds of battles and are elites who have survived countless battlefields. Their combat prowess can be imagined.

Their only weakness is that their own strength level and the level of the biological equipment they equip are not high, and they still need to go through some battles to grow and upgrade.

"Very good! Your army is ready to go to the battlefield!"

"I hope that after being tempered on the battlefield, you can become the most powerful guardian of Daxia Territory!"

Wu Qing praised.

"We are always ready for a rebirth battle!"

Wu Cong replied with some anticipation.

"Get ready when you get back and be ready to go to war at any time!"

"yes!"

The army led by Daxia, which was composed entirely of one-star human soldiers, was comparable to or even surpassed the Earthly Dragoons of the Bugbear clan. It was considered to be Wu Qing's army with the strongest overall combat power.

Thinking of the Earthly Dragoons, Wu Qing thought of the issue of mounts. It was unreasonable for such a powerful army to not even have mounts.

"Wucong, what was your previous mount?"

The choice of mount still depends on the opinion of the wizard. Each race has its own characteristics, and the suitable mounts are also different.

"The most suitable mount for us humans is the war horse!"

"It's just that excellent war horses are relatively rare, so we need to cultivate them ourselves!"

"I happen to have a secret method for breeding war horses here. Except for the high consumption, it is very good in other aspects!"

Wu Cong said, took out a piece of paper from his body, walked forward, handed it to Wu Qing's hand, and then retreated.

Wu Qing held the paper, looked at Wu Cong and said: "The Great Xia leader will not treat anyone badly, and your contribution will be recorded!"

"With the development of Daxia collar, these contributions will be fully and optionally compensated!"

After saying that, Wu Qing withdrew his gaze and stopped looking at the reactions of Wu Cong and the human soldiers.

He looked at the paper in his hand. There were many words written densely on it.

It recorded a method of domesticating various wild horses and breeding them into high-quality war horses. It was written in such detail that Wu Qing took some time to read it.

What Wu Cong said about the high consumption is that a large amount of energy coins are consumed during the breeding process of war horses, and the quality of the bred war horses is related to the energy purity of the energy coins. The higher the energy purity of the energy coins, the better the quality of the bred war horses.

"This is the secret method specially prepared for Daxia Territory!"

"How about this energy coin?"

Wu Qing took out a Zerg energy coin and handed it to Wu Cong, saying with a smile.

"Such a high-purity energy coin is unheard of!"

Wu Cong said in surprise.

He also noticed the patterns on both sides of the Zerg energy coin.

"Is this our own energy coin? It's incredible!"

Zerg and Daxia Territory are one, this is something everyone knows.

"Yes, this is the Zerg energy coin. In the future, we will use this energy coin wherever we need energy coins."

"I'll have someone send you a batch later. The army can use unlimited energy coins for training."

Wu Qing said.

"Thank you for your kindness, lords!"

Wu Cong knew the value of this energy coin and was very grateful to Wu Qing.

He and the newly formed army needed energy coins to restore their strength. With this high-purity Zerg energy coin, their strength recovery speed will be greatly accelerated.

"With such high-purity energy coins in our territory, we can breed the highest quality war horses!"

"I have also explored the surrounding area during this period. There are traces of wild horses nearby. As long as we find them, we can start breeding war horses!"

"With high-quality war horses, our human cavalry in Daxia will become the enemy's nightmare!"

Wu Cong was a little excited. The appearance of Zerg energy coins was a huge surprise. The high-quality war horses that everyone in the human race dreamed of seemed to be within reach!

Which human warrior doesn't love war horses?
